title: Fillable PDF forms leave some controls static by design
symptom: with fillable_forms, controls in stacked upright text (a cell or section in tbRlV, tbLrV or lrTbV), in text boxes turned by other than a right angle, with vertical text or inside another text box, and in tables inside text boxes export as page content, with a diagnostic; the controls of an inline text box export as page content, without a diagnostic
workaround: move the control into upright or turned (not stacked) text, outside nested text boxes and tables in text boxes, and make an inline text box floating
